Chapter 481: Chapter 17 Invincible Lin Yuan (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 481: Chapter 17 Invincible Lin Yuan (Subscribe Please)_2

Then the Martial Ancestor now could casually release a strand of World power that was as vast as three thousand Dao Zhou states.

“Impossible, you, how could you be so strong? Even if it’s an avatar or incarnation, the gap between it and the true self couldn’t possibly be this big…”

Lingxu Immortal King murmured to himself, voicing the doubts that all the Supreme Immortal Kings harbored in their hearts.

The difference in strength between the former and current Martial Ancestors was too great, and even though Lingxu Immortal King knew such a powerful being would not deign to lie, he still refused to believe it.

“That’s something you don’t need to know anymore.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

...

Under normal circumstances, Lin Yuan’s Taiji Primordial Spirit was not much weaker than his true self.

But alas, the Mysterious Gourd had brought about a tenfold increase both to the True Body’s internal world and to the Physical Body.

What did a tenfold increase imply? The internal world expanded from six hundred and eighty thousand square miles to seventy million square miles, and the boost to the power of the World was far beyond a hundred or a few hundred times.

It was precisely because of his vast inner world that Lin Yuan was able to crushingly break into the Seventh Layer of Heaven.

Of course, apart from the physical body and inner world, the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’ that Lin Yuan commanded also widened the gap between his True Self and the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

‘Enhancement’ is a Physical Body Divine Ability that can incidentally boost the spirit will of the soul, but its foundation lies in the physical body. The Taiji Primordial Spirit, which is only the Primordial Spirit Body, is incapable of using this Divine Skill.

However, the ‘Enhancement’ Divine Skill came with side effects. Unless it was absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan would not use this trump card.

Hum.

A thought flickered in Lin Yuan’s mind.

The terrifying power of the World, following the spatial planes of the Seventh Layer of Heaven, directly rolled towards Lingxu Immortal King.

The physical body of Lingxu Immortal King directly turned to dust, the higher Power of Creation— the Power of Annihilation, condensed into a sphere, and fell into the hands of Lin Yuan.

The other types of ordinary Powers of Creation were also integrated by Lin Yuan into his body.

These Powers of Creation, especially the higher Power of Creation, were highly valued by Lin Yuan. Taking them back to the Main World would transform them into higher Cosmic Forces, greatly benefiting his Ninth Rank Dao.

Swish.

After the physical body of Lingxu Immortal King shattered.

An ethereal Soul Body flew out in escape. As a Supreme Immortal King within the Immortal Cultivation System, most of their methods are invested in the soul. Battles between Supreme Immortal Kings rarely end in life or death, largely because the Supreme Immortal Kings at most just give up their physical bodies.

As long as they are willing to escape with their Soul Bodies, they could almost always get away.

“Too terrifying…” The Soul Body of Lingxu Immortal King trembled in spirit. Just now, under the pressure of the power of the World, he nearly failed to escape with his Soul Body.

“This Martial Ancestor, his background is definitely not simple, he must be one of those terrifying beings from the earliest eras…” Lingxu Immortal King’s Soul Body tore through the void, fleeing towards the entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

“You think you can escape?”

Lin Yuan disappeared from where he stood.

The next moment.

Next to Lingxu Immortal King’s Soul Body, a hand reached out and grabbed.

“Ahhhhhh!!”

Lingxu Immortal King’s Soul Body let out a piercing scream and was immediately grasped by Lin Yuan, who proceeded with a Soul Search and then refined it into the purest spiritual power.

…

The Eighth Layer of Heaven.

An area of winding palaces, within a certain side hall.

A man with a face that closely resembled Lingxu Immortal King opened his eyes.

As a Supreme Immortal King who had survived from the Prehistoric Era, Lingxu Immortal King had many life-saving methods; even if his true self perished, he could still ‘resurrect’ within this body that had been prepared long ago.

However, at this moment, Lingxu Immortal King felt no joy from his resurrection. His gaze was filled with worry and unease.

“That Martial Ancestor is too frightening. I have cultivated the Power of Annihilation to the Third Realm and supplemented it with six other ordinary Powers of Creation of the Third Realm, but in front of that Martial Ancestor, I couldn’t even struggle.”

Lingxu Immortal King felt a chill in his heart.

For the long years from the Prehistoric Era to now, he finally felt the breath of death.

It was complete death.

“Given the strength of the Martial Ancestor, he will surely enter the Eighth Layer of Heaven soon…” Lingxu Immortal King steadied his spirit, “I must inform the Chaotic Celestial King and the others…”

In the Prehistoric Era, although Lingxu Immortal King was an outstanding figure among the Supreme Immortal Kings, he was not the strongest.

The ones who could truly be called the strongest Immortal Kings of the ancient past were the Chaotic Celestial Kings, who had led Lingxu Immortal King and the others to take charge of the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

These Supreme Immortal Kings had mastered several high-level powers of creation and had all cultivated to the Third Realm; their strength was immeasurable.

Of course.

In the eyes of the Lingxu Immortal King, even if the strongest Immortal Kings under the Chaotic Celestial King were added together, they would still be far from being a match for the Martial Ancestor.

At least in front of the Chaotic Celestial King, he could still talk back for a while, but the mere thought of resisting the Martial Ancestor was something he dared not even entertain.

But now, the Lingxu Immortal King didn’t have much of a choice, as the Martial Ancestor’s entry into the Eighth Layer of Heaven was imminent; the only thing he could rely on was the Chaotic Celestial King and his peers.

“The Chaotic Celestial King has been studying the Ninth Layer of Heaven for so many years, perhaps he has figured out some kind of killing move that can stop the Martial Ancestor…”

The Lingxu Immortal King had felt the power of the Martial Ancestor and didn’t even dream that the Chaotic Celestial King and the others would be able to repel, let alone defeat him.

If they could just barely hold him off, it would be a fortune from the heavens.

…

After Lin Yuan conducted a Soul Search on the Lingxu Immortal King, he learned many secrets about the Eighth Layer of Heaven and the Prehistoric Era.

“So it turns out that the group of Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era, led by the Chaotic Celestial King, the Chaotic Celestial King had realized four kinds of high-level powers of creation and had also cultivated them to the Third Realm.”

“After the end of the Prehistoric Era, the Chaotic Celestial King led a group of Supreme Immortal Kings to ascend to the Eighth Layer of Heaven and has been trying to reach the Ninth Layer of Heaven ever since, but to this day, they have yet to succeed…”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

The Chaotic Celestial King had realized four kinds of high-level powers of creation and cultivated them all to the Third Realm; in this respect, Lin Yuan couldn’t compare.

Although Lin Yuan had also realized four kinds of high-level powers of creation, they were all at the First Realm.

But Lin Yuan also possessed an Inner World with a radius of seventy million miles, and with the vast expanse of his Inner World, he didn’t consider the Chaotic Celestial King a concern.

“Has it not been long enough, and still, they have not ascended to the Ninth Layer of Heaven?” Lin Yuan was very interested in the Chaotic Celestial King; the four types of powers of creation the other party possessed probably included one or two that Lin Yuan had not realized.

“Them?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze turned to the battlefield, looking towards the other Supreme Immortal Kings.

“Run…”

“Quick, back to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.”

The Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era fled without hesitation towards the entrance to the Eighth Layer of Heaven.

What a joke.

If they did not run now, were they waiting to follow the same path as the Lingxu Immortal King?

Although they didn’t know the full extent of Lin Yuan’s strength, just based on the means he used to kill the Lingxu Immortal King, he was far beyond what they could handle.

As for joining forces and resisting together…

When the gap in strength reached a certain level, the advantage of numbers would no longer be an advantage, unless it was the ‘Sea of Bugs Tactics’ used in the Main World.

Otherwise, dozens of Supreme Immortal Kings, in front of Lin Yuan, would likely be no more significant than toys, to be trifled with at will.

Lin Yuan did not stop these Supreme Immortal Kings from their mass flee.

There was mainly no need, since above was the Eighth Layer of Heaven, so where could these Supreme Immortal Kings even escape to.

For a moment.

Within the Seventh Layer of Heaven, only Lin Yuan, the Open Heaven Immortal King, the Supreme Immortal King, and more than twenty other Immortal Kings were left.

“Martial Ancestor…”

A moment later, the Open Heaven Immortal King mustered the courage, approached Lin Yuan, and tried to speak.

“Open Heaven.” Lin Yuan gave a faint smile, voluntarily reined in his aura, and casually greeted him.

During the three hundred years, Lin Yuan had a pleasant time interacting with the Open Heaven Immortal King, the Supreme Immortal King, and the various Supreme Immortal Kings; he did not intend to leverage his strength to overwhelm at this moment.

The response from Lin Yuan let the Open Heaven Immortal King breathe a small sigh of relief; at least by speaking this way, Lin Yuan was treating him as one of his own.

He didn’t need to be as terrified as those Supreme Immortal Kings from the Prehistoric Era.

“Martial Ancestor, what kind of power of creation have you mastered exactly?” Seeing this, the Supreme Immortal King stepped forward as well, unable to contain his curiosity.

The power Lin Yuan had just displayed was terrifying, and if he had not lacked some of the characteristics that were legendary for a king above an Immortal King, they would have almost believed Lin Yuan had already taken that step.

“What kind of power of creation?”

Lin Yuan shook his head, “Should it be considered ‘Cosmic Force’?”

The Cosmic Force nurtured within the Inner World was a power entirely different from the power of creation and cosmic force; it depended on the Inner World one had opened up.

It didn’t require enlightenment; as long as one had opened up an Inner World, one could master it.
